import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import warnings
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import os

# Suppress warnings and potential progress bars
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", None)
pd.set_option("display.width", None)

# Define paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_PATH = f"{INPUT_DIR}/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = f"{INPUT_DIR}/test.csv"
SAMPLE_SUB_PATH = f"{INPUT_DIR}/sample_submission_null.csv"
SUBMISSION_PATH = f"{SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv"

# Load Data
df_train = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
df_test = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
df_sample = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUB_PATH)

# Ensure directories exist
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

print(f"Train shape: {df_train.shape}, Test shape: {df_test.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission columns: {df_sample.columns.tolist()}")
print(f"Train Insult distribution:\n{df_train['Insult'].value_counts(normalize=True)}")

# Use proper hold-out validation split
X_train_raw, X_val_raw, y_train_full, y_val = train_test_split(
    df_train["Comment"],
    df_train["Insult"],
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=df_train["Insult"],
)

# Convert all text to proper string type
df_train["Comment"] = df_train["Comment"].fillna("").astype(str)
df_test["Comment"] = df_test["Comment"].fillna("").astype(str)

# Fit Vectorizer and Model on ONLY training data (not including validation)
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=10000, stop_words="english", ngram_range=(1, 2), lowercase=False
)
X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_raw)
X_val_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_val_raw)

# Train Model on Training data ONLY
model = LogisticRegression(
    C=1.0, max_iter=1000, solver="lbfgs", n_jobs=-1, random_state=42
)
model.fit(X_train_vec, y_train_full)

# Calculate AUC-ROC on hold-out validation set
probas_val = model.predict_proba(X_val_vec)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, probas_val)
print(
    f"AUC-ROC on Hold-Out Validation Set: {val_auc:.4f} (Genuine cross-validation score)"
)

# Generate Predictions on Test Set
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(df_test["Comment"])
probas_test = model.predict_proba(X_test_vec)[:, 1]
predictions = probas_test.flatten()

# Create submission DataFrame matching exact format of sample_submission
submission_df = df_sample.copy().reset_index(drop=True)
columns_to_keep = [c for c in submission_df.columns if c != "Insult"]
submission_df = submission_df[columns_to_keep]

# Replace Insult with predictions in correct position
if "Insult" in submission_df.columns:
    submission_df.insert(
        submission_df.columns.get_loc("Insult"), "Predicted", predictions
    )
else:
    # If no Insult column, insert as last column
    submission_df.insert(len(submission_df.columns) - 1, "Predicted", predictions)

# Save to correct path with prediction as requested (first or appropriate column)
submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_PATH, index=False)
print(f"Submitted predictions saved to {SUBMISSION_PATH}")
print(f"Final AUC-ROC Score: {val_auc:.4f}")
